stage0080_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Is that supposed to be a threat...」

stage0080_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$マヤ$$
「It's locked from the plug side」

stage0080_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マコト$$
「Stop it, $$シンジ$$!
　Think about what you're doing!」

stage0080_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Keep talking and you'll only make me angrier.
　Unit-01's got 285 seconds left...
　That's enough to wreck half of HQ.」

stage0080_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$シゲル$$
「The way he is now, he just might」

stage0080_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$マヤ$$
「$$シンジ$$, listen to me!
　If not for Commander Ikari's decision,
　you might have been killed!」

stage0080_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$マヤ$$
「Once the Angel's erosion spread through
　the whole plug, even $c had no choice!」

stage0080_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I said that doesn't matter to me!
　Father... he tried to kill $$アスカ$$!
　With... with these very hands of mine!」

stage0080_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Why! Why! Why does it have to be like this!
　Father doesn't understand anything at all!
　I was a fool to have trusted him!」

stage0080_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I hope father loses someone precious too!
　Then he'll finally understand!
　Then he will!! Then he will...!!」

stage0080_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Raise the LCL compression to its limit」

stage0080_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I have no time to indulge a child's tantrum」

stage0080_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Did you do something from outside!?」

stage0080_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But the direct control circuit still...
　Gh... agh... my mind is...」

stage0080_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Taking up our time and effort.
　Begin the retrieval...」

stage0080_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$マコト$$
「Wait, please!
　Someone's infiltrated the Geofront!?」

stage0080_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$マコト$$
「Pattern can't be identified!
　It's coming!」

stage0080_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ニア$$
「Earth's humanity, attempting to trespass
　into the forbidden domain...」

stage0080_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$マヤ$$
「All communication devices have been hijacked!」

stage0080_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ニア$$
「You do not deserve the mercy of the Prison of Time」

stage0080_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ニア$$
「I am a messenger, come to tell you of despair...
　The $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ declares annihilation
　upon Earth's humanity once more」

stage0080_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シゲル$$
「So $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ is the mysterious
　cosmic life form that appeared before
　the $$新世時空震動$$...!」

stage0080_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ボビー$$
「So this is the Geofront, beneath
　$$第３新東京市$$...」

stage0080_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$キャシー$$
「$$アドヴェント$$ had the entry code to this place,
　a fortress built to prevent Third Impact...」

stage0080_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The power of Chrono... formidable indeed」

stage0080_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$シモン$$!
　Look at that!」

stage0080_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$シモン$$
「Why!?
　Why are you the messenger again!?」

stage0080_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ニア$$
「I was, from the very start, born as
　a terminal of the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...
　A virtual life form, so to speak...」

stage0080_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ニア$$
「I'm only someone who woke from
　sleep, now that the time has come」

stage0080_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$キタン$$
「You saying that's your real form!?」

stage0080_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「If you've taken that form, then...」

stage0080_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ニア$$
「Then, $$シモン$$...
　I will tell you of despair once more」

stage0080_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ニア$$
「The $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ will
　annihilate Earth's humanity,
　even should the Prison of Time be completed」

stage0080_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ニア$$
「After all, this star's existence cannot be allowed.
　Nor can those who seek to claim it」

stage0080_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$マコト$$
「Dimensional tremor detected!
　Something's crossing space and appearing!」

stage0080_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You feeble humans...!
　I've no time to bother with you now!」

stage0080_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Puppet, go back and tell the Anti-Spirals!
　This star belongs to us!」

stage0080_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ニア$$
「Foolish...
　You who worship only power
　have no right to call yourselves gods」

stage0080_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ニア$$
「Gods of Olympus.
　You are no different from $$バアル$$」

stage0080_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Says the coward...!
　What right do you have, you who fled the real war!」

stage0080_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ニア$$
「Ignorance truly is a frightening thing.
　Climbing the steps toward a higher life form,
　yet unable to admit your own powerlessness...」

stage0080_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ニア$$
「Then perhaps you too should taste despair」

stage0080_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Seems you mean to fight us」

stage0080_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Hmph... just a skirmish before the real war, is it」

stage0080_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Very well.
　Shall we teach the cowardly Anti-Spirals
　who will become overlord of the entire universe」

stage0080_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't go talking whatever the hell you want!!」

stage0080_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$シモン$$
「Gods, annihilation, overlords, whatever!
　Don't ignore us and get hyped up on your own!!」

stage0080_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$, out to annihilate humanity,
　and the Mycenaeans doing as they please on Earth...!
　Either way, they're both our enemies!」

stage0080_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Still don't understand...!
　That in a war of gods and devils, much less
　a war between gods, there's no room for humans!」

stage0080_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Quiet, Mycenae!
　See for yourself if we're really powerless!!」

stage0080_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ニア$$
「Ignorance and recklessness... and the power
　they create... You truly do seem to be
　the ones at the forefront of evolution」

stage0080_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（An odd way of phrasing that...）

stage0080_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ニア$$
「For that reason, you must be annihilated...」

stage0080_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ニア$$
「Farewell, $$シモン$$.
　No miracle will happen again...」

stage0080_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$シモン$$!
　Fight the enemy in front of you now!!」

stage0080_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$冬月$$
「So they choose the path of battle, after all...」

stage0080_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$アルト$$
（$$シンジ$$...
　Leave this to us）

stage0080_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$n
（Rest your heart for now...!
　We couldn't protect $$アスカ$$, but we'll protect you!）

stage0080_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$オズマ$$
「All units!
　It's a three-way fight between the
　$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$, the Mycenaeans, and us!」

stage0080_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$隼人$$
「Watch for pincer attacks!
　Especially from the $$ミケーネ神$$!」

stage0080_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Here I come, Mycenae!
　I won't let you call yourselves gods!!」

stage0080_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$!
　Don't think you can wipe out humanity
　and us that easily!!」

stage0080_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$柿小路$$
「This won't do, not like this!」

stage0080_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Taking both of them on is tough, even for us!」

stage0080_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$n
「Don't start whining!
　We're doing this to protect $$シンジ$$ too!」

stage0080_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$キタン$$
「This is bad!
　A faceless bastard, over there...!」

stage0080_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「No good!
　We won't make it from here!」

stage0080_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$n
「He stopped the attack with an A.T. Field...!」

stage0080_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$マコト$$
「Did it climb the elevator under its own power!?」

stage0080_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I don't recall ordering a sortie」

stage0080_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Do you think that's something
　that would be allowed?」

stage0080_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Just because you're my father doesn't
　mean you can stop me!」

stage0080_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$ pilot,
　$$碇シンジ$$!」

stage0080_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'm counting on you, $$シンジ$$」

stage0080_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$マリ$$
「I'm $$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$.
　Just a passing EVA pilot.」

stage0080_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「So she'd slipped into Japan...」

stage0080_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$マリ$$
「Now then, little pup.
　Let's fight together.」

stage0080_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$マリ$$
「Nice scent...
　Someone else's EVA isn't bad either.
　...Let's get to it!」

stage0080_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$甲児$$
「See that, Mycenae!
　Humans aren't as weak as you think!」

stage0080_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Humans are creatures that grow!
　Even if we can't beat you now, we'll get stronger!!」

stage0080_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$!
　If you won't allow that,
　then we'll resist with everything we have!」

stage0080_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's our fight... that's what it means to live!!」

stage0080_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$不動$$
「No... this is where it begins.」

stage0080_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$キタン$$
「Both $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ and Mycenae
　can go straight to hell!」

stage0080_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「There's no time to grieve.
　Not for you, not for this planet.」

stage0080_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The battle at Dakar is over, too...
　And I hear Lady $$ニア$$ appeared over there
　as well, delivering a declaration of war.」

stage0080_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「So unlike last time, they didn't send
　a message out to the whole world this time?」

stage0080_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Their target is $$シモン$$... and us, then?」

stage0080_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Guess losing to us really pissed 'em off.」

stage0080_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$甲児$$
「If that's how they want it,
　we'll settle this completely this time...!」

stage0080_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$バナージ$$ and Ensign $$リディ$$ are back
　with the unit. I hear the detached force
　is heading to Japan too, to plan ahead.」

stage0080_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$葵$$
「As $$エタニティ・フラット$$'s completion nears,
　things are getting noisy everywhere, huh.」

stage0080_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$タケル$$
「Every organization's bound to make its move.」

stage0080_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$アルト$$
「The time for the final battle is near...」

stage0080_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...I'm going to step out for a bit.」

stage0080_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「You'll come back, right, $$シンジ$$?」

stage0080_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$赤木$$
「This is where you belong, you know.」

stage0080_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ミカ$$
「$$ムガン$$'s been shot down by Mycenae!」

stage0080_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ナオト$$
「It'd help if $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ and Mycenae
　just wiped each other out like this.」

stage0080_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アキラ$$
「And then we take out whoever's left, huh?」

stage0080_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「Things won't always go that conveniently.
　We'll fight this with our own strength.」

stage0080_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ミカ$$
「Mycenae's been shot down by $$ムガン$$!」

stage0080_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ナオト$$
「It'd help if $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ and Mycenae
　just wiped each other out like this.」

stage0080_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$アキラ$$
「And then we take out whoever's left, huh?」

stage0080_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「Things won't always go that conveniently.
　We'll fight this with our own strength.」

stage0080_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$甲児$$
「Watch closely, Mycenae!
　I'll show you the human strength you call powerless!」

stage0080_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$甲児$$
「As long as we're here,
　don't think you can have things your way!!」

stage0080_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$シモン$$
（Wait for me, $$ニア$$!
　I'll definitely come get you!）

stage0080_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$シモン$$
「Come on then, $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$!
　I'll fight you to the very end,
　until you can't touch Earth or $$ニア$$ again!!」

stage0080_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$キタン$$
「You faceless bastards!
　Thought I'd never see your ugly mugs again,
　but you just don't learn, do ya!」

stage0080_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$キタン$$
「Then I'll teach you a lesson to the bone!
　Earth's got the Dai-Gurren Brigade and $c,
　and this $$キタン$$, you hear!!」

stage0080_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「I can't forgive this...
　The nerve, to talk about wiping out people
　who are doing their best to live...!」

stage0080_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Most of all, dragging $$ニア$$ into this again,
　right when she was at the height of happiness,
　about to marry $$シモン$$!」

stage0080_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Let's do this, $$ダリー$$!
　We won't let $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ have its way!」

stage0080_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ダリー$$
「I know!
　For $$シモン$$'s sake too, we have to
　get $$ニア$$ back, no matter what!」

stage0080_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It's not for my father's sake...
　I pilot EVA for myself,
　and for the people precious to me...!」

stage0080_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm not... my father's puppet!
　I'm $c's $$碇シンジ$$!!」

stage0080_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$マリ$$
（It's such an emergency, so no one's
　going to complain if I pilot an EVA, right?）

stage0080_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$マリ$$
（But since I'm piloting, I'll do it...!
　That's exactly why I'm here!）

stage0080_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（Ikari said goodbye to that person...）
